name: GoliathCrop
tagline: Crop management on GoliathApp: fields, operations, sensors, imagery, and research trials.
description: GoliathCrop specializes GoliathApp for commercial farms and research stations. It records farms, fields and plots (PostGIS), seasons, plantings, operations (irrigation, fertilization, spraying, harvest), inputs inventory, soil and tissue samples, scouting, and yield. Sensor readings live in TimescaleDB hypertables in the same PostgreSQL database behind the stored-procedure API. Satellite and drone rasters are stored as COGs on S3-compatible long-term storage with footprints in PostGIS. DomainPrograms for weather sync, NDVI processing, irrigation scheduling, and alerts claim tasks through goliath-gateway, with Postgres pub/sub wake for event-triggered work. This repository holds the catalog entry and plan; implementation is planned.

features.title: Fields, seasons, and operations
features.description: PostGIS field and plot geometry, plantings by season, and a log of irrigation, fertilization, spraying, and harvest with inputs inventory.

features.title: Sensors, weather, and imagery
features.description: TimescaleDB sensor readings, free weather providers (Open-Meteo, NOAA), and Sentinel-2/Landsat NDVI stored as COGs.

features.title: Research trials in the MVP
features.description: Plots, treatments, replicates, and observations for research stations alongside commercial farm records.

features.title: DomainPrograms with dual activation
features.description: Backlog work is claimed through goliath-gateway; event-triggered work (new imagery, readings, thresholds) wakes workers via Postgres pub/sub.
